commentary.text: ARAQUEREYNA's well-regarded team offers notable experience in the Venezuelan tax space. Its noted bench of strong practitioners possesses significant expertise in advising on a range of transactional, contentious and advisory tax mandates. The department's expertise spans tax planning and achieving tax efficiency for corporate transactions. The firm is also adept at handling administrative litigation as well as advising on currency exchange regulations. The team provides additional capabilities by assisting individuals with estate planning and wealth management.
